name: Platinum Vape Disposable | Runtz
description:
Sweet. Loud. Full of life.

Runtz brings a fruity explosion of tropical candy and citrus with a smooth, creamy finish that keeps every hit tasting like pure sugar rush. This sativa distillate is all about vibe elevation — sparking energy, focus, and a euphoric mood that lasts from sunrise to session’s end.

Built with Platinum’s ultra-pure distillate and advanced dual-coil airflow tech, the 2G all-in-one delivers thick clouds, bright flavor, and a clean, consistent pull every time.

Flavor Profile: Tropical Candy • Citrus • Creamy Sweet

Effect: Uplifted • Euphoric • Focused

Device: Rechargeable 2G Distillate Disposable • All-In-One • Smooth Draw Design
